record.label: Logical spacetime bound for one 333-qubit run
record.statement: Appendix I.4 reports 333 logical qubits and 1,310,839,337 T gates, giving a product of 436,509,499,221 qubit–T.
record.boundary: The width in the theorem is 116 + 217 = 333. With that width, the product bound gives at most 1,310,839,337 T gates. A measurement contributes zero to this count, and a measurement-dependent conditional contributes the larger T count of its branches.
